title: AWS SDK for Java V3 model provenance, format 1
description: META-INF/aws-sdk-java-v3/services/<package>/model-provenance.json in every generated service artifact: the exact service shape ID and the untruncated immutable revision of the canonical Smithy model it was generated from (Requirements 2.12, 22.2). Written by aws-codegen with sorted keys, two-space indentation and \n line endings.

revision.description: Exact revision: the full Git commit object ID (40 or 64 lower-case hex digits) of the canonical model source, or, for unpinned generation only, the model digest.

files.description: Every canonical model file, sorted by path.

shapeId.description: Absolute Smithy shape ID (namespace#Name), exactly as modeled.

relativePath.description: Relative path with / separators; never absolute, never escaping its root.
